description: _project/specs/uat-framework.md:140 (module table) and :517 (make-target table) both describe tests/uat/artifact_hygiene.py as applying/no-opping 'unless an external output root is configured'. PR #1300 (anchor-benchmark-runs-default-to-worktree-parent, w6) changed configured_external_root() to fall back to the resolved default root, so the guard now also covers runs with no --output and no BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR -- the default root is itself external. Both descriptions are therefore stale. The module-table row is regenerated by _project/scripts/uat_loc_table.py, so check whether the description text is sourced from that script or hand-maintained in the spec before editing, and fix whichever is authoritative. Deferred from #1300 because _project/specs/ was outside that item's only_modify allowlist; only the numeric LOC regeneration was force-included by the pre-commit drift guard.
